title: ECoSim: Data Efficient Fine-Tuning for Controllable Traffic Simulation

control_signal.value: Trajectory sketch (future waypoints), latent behavior code from a BehaviorVAE, or natural-language command; behaviors can be retrieved from other agents and transferred into a scene.

control_mechanism.value: Small adapters predict FiLM scale and shift for decoder layers of a frozen backbone, identity-initialized, trained with closed-loop fine-tuning. Logits-level classifier-free guidance is used for counterfactual rollouts.

base_model.value: Frozen pretrained VBD (diffusion) and SMART (autoregressive) traffic models; DistilBERT with LoRA for text; BehaviorVAE for latents.

datasets.value: Waymo Open Motion Dataset with the Waymo Open Sim Agents Challenge protocol; BehaviorVAE trained on 10,000 training scenarios; text from ProSim-Instruct-520k.

metrics.value: Realism: WOSAC Meta score. Control: mADE and relative mADE gain. Counterfactual: Control ADE, maneuver success rate, coverage, collision, offroad, closed-loop PDMScore.

controllability_evidence.value: Adapters reduce control error by up to 83% and raise WOSAC Meta by 0.02-0.03, using 0.01%-1% paired data. Counterfactual sketch control: Control ADE 0.3727 m, success 70.61%.

stated_limitations.value: May favor control satisfaction over safe interaction when instructions conflict with traffic (sudden-brake and at-fault collisions); controls a single agent; retrieved counterfactuals are imbalanced toward simple behaviors.

notes: Evaluation controls are derived from ground-truth trajectories (oracle) per the paper; family label chosen because control inputs are trained into an adapter, not applied by guidance.
